_comment: What people say (docs/PHASE4.md, step 4). Marco: a farmer-trader working the old road, friendly and careful. Trust level 1 after the first trade (DESIGN.md M1 row 2). Doc (docs/PHASE6.md, 4): a doctor somewhere up the highway, by sat-phone only; he sells services, flat per kind, and stays a character. Marco's trust 2 comes with your first run to Las Cruces. Ray (docs/PHASE7.md, 3): the dam's engineer, by sat-phone; he sells plans and parts at a premium, buys nothing, and gives the uplink plans once your hydro generator turns.

marco.name: Marco
marco.first: “You found my number, then. Marco. I trade up and down this road: salt, nails, cloth, a bit of everything. I pay in coin, the digital kind, same as I am paid. Half what I sell for, mind. A man has to eat.”
again: “Back again. Good. What do you need?”
“The road is quiet today. Let’s see what you have.”
“Careful past the farm. Those dogs have gone wild.”
“You look like a man who walks a long way for his salt.”
marco.callDay: “Bueno. I will be at the bus shelter on the old road. Come by daylight.”
marco.callNight: “Not in the dark, friend. The coyotes own the road at night. I will be at the shelter in the morning.”
marco.callWaiting: “I said I would be there, and I will. By the bus shelter, by day.”
marco.trust: Marco nods slowly. He trusts you a little now (trust 1).
marco.strike: Marco steps back, hands up. “Easy, friend. Easy.”
marco.bye: Marco tips his hat and goes back to the road.
marco.trust2: “You’ve been up to Las Cruces and come back. Not many do. Now I can sell you real things: guns, rounds. Don’t tell anyone where you got them.” (Marco trusts you more now: trust 2.)

doc.name: Doc
doc.card: A card on the counter: “Dr. R. Ibáñez — médico. Sat-phone.” A number underneath, in pen. His number is in your phone now: call him from the cave.
doc.first: “Ibáñez. Who gave you this num… the pharmacy card. Of course. I’m a doctor, or I was. I can talk you through what your kit can do, if you can pay. Coin. Flat fee, whatever it is.”
again: “You again. Good: it means you’re alive.”
“Keep out of the yellow signs, my friend. I can’t make you new blood.”
“I’m listening. Slowly, please. The line is bad.”
doc.wound: “Clean it, pack it, close it. There. Rest a day and don’t fall off anything.”
doc.rad: “Iodine first, then the blue sachets: the whole box, with water, over the hour. It binds what you breathed and ate. Your blood will thank you.”
doc.notHurt: “You sound fine to me. Call when you’re not.”
doc.noDose: “No dose to treat. Keep it that way.”
doc.funds: “The coin first, my friend. I have to eat too.”

ray.name: Ray
ray.logbook: Logbook, Presa Río Seco. The last two years of entries are in one hand: “R. Quispe, ing.” Inside the cover, a sat-phone number, and: “If the lights are still on, someone call me.” His number is in your phone now: call him from the cave.
ray.first: “…Quispe. Who is this? You read my logbook. Then the lights are still on. Ha. Eight years, and she still turns. I ran that dam alone for two years after, until the cenizos came up from the yards. I can’t go back. But I can sell you drawings, and parts, if you have coin. I don’t buy: I have no use for your scrap.”
again: “The Seco goes underground below my dam, you know. Nobody ever found where it comes out.”
“By day they stand like posts. Walk. Never run, never shoot unless you mean to leave.”
“Stay under the lamps. I left them on for a reason.”
ray.plansBought: “Micro-hydro: a runner, a generator, a penstock you can build from pipe. Put it where the water moves. You’ll need the runner and the core from my powerhouse, and the sluice tools from the locker there. Get it turning, then call me.”
ray.notYet: “Is it turning yet? Water through the runner, current on the meter. Then call me.”
ray.uplink: “It turns? Then you can build what I never could. I’m sending you drawings: a satellite uplink. There is something up there that still answers, if you ask it the right way. You’ll need an antenna, and the only one left standing is on the ridge tower, north-west, past everything. Not yet. But now you have the drawings.” (Ray’s uplink plans are in your pack.)
ray.uplinkFull: “I have drawings for you. Make room in your pack and call again.”
